note: F24 depreciation by asset class, FY2023-24 (rows 38–56): the year's depreciation of each class (G) is NPCL's figure — given, never counted as reproduced; closing gross block (E) and closing accumulated depreciation (I) from the opening, additions and deductions; the total (G57), less the depreciation on consumer-contribution assets (G60, printed negative), is the net (G61) the ARR format carries (ARR!G36). The FY2023-24 block's rate column divides by the net block (B − F) where the other years divide by the gross; not checked (ledger A38).

blank_is_zero.why: classes with nothing (capital spares, spare units, assets not belonging to the utility) leave cells blank; NPCL's SUMs read the blanks as zero

record:gfa_grants.why: F24 has no grants column per class; grants would be deducted below the total ('Less: Grants', blank)
